methods.name: infer_partitions
methods.signature: async fn infer_partitions(&self, state: &dyn Session, table_path: &ListingTableUrl) -> datafusion_common::Result<Vec<String>>
methods.summary: Infer the partitioning at the given path on the provided object store. For performance reasons, it doesn't read all the files on disk and therefore may fail to detect invalid partitioning.
